categories.main_business_segments: Hanchang Paper Co., Ltd primarily operates in the manufacturing and wholesale of manila and white cardboard paper. The company focuses on industrial packaging paper, including cigarette packaging, food packaging, and eco-friendly paper products. It operates as a single business segment centered on paperboard manufacturing.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes all-pulp board dedicated manufacturing facilities, being the first in Korea to adopt such technology. Production involves advanced paperboard manufacturing processes with continuous investment in new equipment to improve productivity and quality. Research and development focus on eco-friendly materials, functional specialty papers, and innovative coating technologies.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include industrial packaging users such as confectionery, food companies, cigarette manufacturers (e.g., KT&G), and publishers of infant books. The company serves both domestic wholesalers and direct end-users, as well as international markets through exports. The packaging paper market is closely linked to light industry sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations are primarily based in South Korea with manufacturing facilities in Yangsan, Gyeongsangnam-do. The company serves domestic markets extensively and exports to overseas customers, with export sales accounting for approximately 34.7% of total sales. It maintains a nationwide distribution network through its headquarters and logistics centers.
categories.supply_chain_position: Hanchang Paper operates midstream in the supply chain as a manufacturer and wholesaler of paperboard products. It sources raw materials such as pulp and recycled paper primarily from global suppliers and domestic recyclers, then produces finished paperboard products for industrial packaging customers downstream.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes technological innovation in eco-friendly paper products and cost reduction through production efficiency. R&D efforts focus on developing biodegradable materials, functional specialty papers with infrared and anion properties, and environmentally sustainable coatings. Continuous investment in new production facilities and quality improvement is a strategic priority.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through the sale of manufactured paperboard products, including white cardboard and other paper types. Sales channels include domestic wholesale and direct sales to industrial customers, as well as export sales via trading companies and direct overseas customers. Payment terms vary between cash, credit, and letters of credit for exports.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: While specific competitors are not detailed, the company holds an estimated 19.8% domestic market share in white cardboard paper as of 2023, indicating a strong market position. The paper industry is capital intensive with high barriers to entry, and Hanchang Paper is positioned as a leading domestic manufacturer with advanced technology adoption.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company reported sales of approximately KRW 276 billion, a 28.4% increase from the previous year, driven by new production capacity and expanded sales volume. Despite revenue growth, it recorded an operating loss due to rising raw material and energy costs. Total assets were about KRW 289 billion with liabilities increasing due to facility investments and borrowings, reflecting a mid-sized company with recent growth and investment activity.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Hanchang Paper emphasizes high-quality, eco-friendly, and functional specialty paper products that meet industrial packaging needs. Its competitive edge lies in pioneering all-pulp board manufacturing technology, continuous R&D for innovative and sustainable materials, and a diversified product portfolio tailored for high-margin industrial applications. The company also focuses on cost competitiveness through operational efficiency and supply chain management.
